verdict.rationale: The evidence pack consists entirely of xAI's own capability/feature docs (tool calling, structured outputs, pricing, rate limits, retention, model specs) and third-party community reports of weaknesses (e.g. grok-comm-3, grok-comm-4, grok-comm-16) — but no first-party doc page enumerating known limitations, failure modes, biases, or weak spots of the models themselves. Community complaints don't count as vendor self-documentation, and none of the docs items (specs, pricing, migration, reasoning controls) constitute a 'what the model is bad at' disclosure.
